verdict: Morgan Stanley earned $4.9B as wealth management posted record revenue of $9.1B and Wall Street trading stayed strong — total revenue rose 12% to $20.3B.

kpis.label: Wealth Management revenue
kpis.note: a record, with a 30.4% pre-tax margin

kpis.label: Credit costs
kpis.note: provision for credit losses, on loan growth

segments.name: Institutional Securities
segments.note: Trading ($5.6B), investment banking ($2.4B) and lending for big institutions — the markets business had a strong quarter.

segments.name: Wealth Management
segments.note: Advising wealthy households — record revenue and a 30.4% pre-tax margin; the steady business Morgan Stanley has spent a decade building.

segments.name: Investment Management
segments.note: Managing funds for institutions and individuals — the soft spot this quarter.

segments.name: Other
segments.note: Corporate and funding items, including higher funding costs — a negative that brings the segments to total revenue.

opex.note: Pay for 80,000+ bankers, traders and advisors — 39% of revenue, the firm's biggest cost.

opex.name: Other non-compensation expenses
opex.note: Professional services ($700M), occupancy and equipment ($502M), marketing ($347M) and other costs ($1,397M).

opex.name: Brokerage, clearing & exchange fees
opex.note: The cost of executing and clearing trades.

opex.name: Information processing & communications
opex.note: Technology and data — the firm's systems bill.

otherDetail: For a bank, the P&L runs straight from revenue-less-credit-costs-less-expenses to pre-tax income of $6,478M; there is no separate 'other income' block of size.
follow100Note: Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Wealth is now half the firm
takeaways.text: Wealth Management set a revenue record at $9.1B with a 30.4% pre-tax margin — nearly matching the $10.0B from the historically dominant trading and banking side.

takeaways.title: Markets businesses fired
takeaways.text: Institutional Securities revenue rose 18%: trading brought in $5.6B (+12%) and investment banking $2.4B (+4%) as dealmaking recovered.

takeaways.title: Asset management lagged
takeaways.text: Investment Management revenue fell 12% to $1.5B and its pre-tax profit fell to $259M — the one business moving the wrong way.

footerNote: For a bank, the provision for credit losses ($148M) plays the role of cost of revenue. Net income was $4,969M; after $60M to noncontrolling interests, $4,909M was applicable to Morgan Stanley, and after $158M of preferred dividends, $4,751M remained for common shareholders — the basis for the $3.03 EPS.
